note: Machine-readable port provenance. tools/ports-provenance.py hashes each artifact, writes ports/<id>/PROVENANCE.md and syncs the matching catalog fields. Paths are absolute because the 18 GB source tree is never vendored into this repo.

ports.build: ./gradlew android:assembleDebug  (JDK 21; keep minifyEnabled true — without R8 desugaring the app dies on boot with AbstractMethodError)
ports.notes: The Arc engine it depends on is pinned locally at cloned-free-games/games/Arc (commit 7445105cd2). Campaign is fully offline; LAN multiplayer is optional and never required.

ports.build: ./gradlew android:assembleDebug  (LibGDX + gdx-freetype; needs JDK 21 and the Android SDK at local.properties)
ports.notes: Single-player roguelike, no network code at all. The deepest permadeath dungeon crawler in the collection.

ports.build: cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug  (NDK 28.2; the ABI-split build produces app-<abi>-debug.apk per target)
ports.notes: Sandbox voxel world; single-player and LAN are both offline-capable. Four ABI-split APKs exist in the clone — arm64-v8a is the one shipped here. No content mods are bundled; the base game is complete on its own.

ports.build: cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && ninja -C build  (then run build/endless-sky)
ports.notes: No Android APK is checked into the clone; the verified artifact is the desktop build. For phones, use the project's official Android release or stream it from a desktop host. Open-world space trading and combat, entirely offline.

ports.build: make sdl-release  (then copy the freely redistributable shareware pak0.pak into id1/ and run ./darkplaces-sdl -basedir .)
ports.notes: Quake engine. Ships instructions to fetch the shareware pak only — never a retail pak. Timedemo measured at 98.5 fps average on the reference machine.

A 132 MB Android APK (org.ddnet.client 20.1.1) also exists at /home/cluer/projects/cloned-free-games/apks/ddnet.apk. The verified artifact here is the desktop binary. Practice and local servers play offline; public servers need the network, so it is the one title whose best mode is online.
